page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4r.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance includes 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage, offering low-latency data access directly on the host. For network connectivity, it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated local SSD storage, the ecs.i4r.4xlarge offers a balanced resource density for memory-intensive and storage-reliant workloads without the overhead of external storage attachments. This hardware profile is suited for database hosting, memory-intensive caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring dedicated CPU resources and fast local storage.
